FAQ

Oversized & Boxy T-Shirts questions

What's the difference between oversized and boxy?

Oversized is longer and wider all over; boxy is wide but shorter in the body. Read our fit guide.

Can you match a fit I like?

Yes, send us a reference tee and we copy the measurements.
